sources: Official MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com): schedule endpoint confirms the fixture; standings endpoint (all 30 teams) gives 2026 regular-season W-L, runs scored and runs allowed. League average computed from the full table: 21,769 runs over 4,858 team-games = 4.481 runs/team/game.
model: Money Line: team strength = average of actual win% and Pythagorean expected win% (from RS/RA); log5 head-to-head, then a home-field log-odds shift of +0.16 (about a 54% home win rate between equals). Run Line (-1.5) and Game Totals: independent Poissons with lambda_team = (own RS/game x opponent RA/game / league average), home scoring factor x1.03 (away /1.03). Probable starting pitchers had NOT been announced on the official schedule at verification time, so this is a team-level model - flagged.

Tampa Bay Rays.splits: Away 43-38; one-run games 25-14 (outperformed run differential by 8 wins)
Tampa Bay Rays.note: AL East champions, AL's best record.

Milwaukee Brewers.note: Best record in MLB in 2026; second-most runs scored (832, behind the Cubs' 850) and second-fewest allowed (618, behind the Dodgers' 600).

matches.form_context: Milwaukee own MLB's best record (103-59) with a +214 run differential and a 55-26 home record; their Pythagorean record matches their actual record exactly, so no luck adjustment applies. Tampa Bay won 98 games but their underlying run differential (+86) profiles closer to a 90-win team - they went 25-14 in one-run games.
matches.flag: Probable starting pitchers not yet announced on the official MLB schedule; team-level model only.
